candidate_rationale: The two original fresh-seed primary passers that were not variance-stability flagged.
reuse_rationale: These are the baseline seeds from the completed post-2019 diagnosis-disruption audit. Reuse makes the descriptive ledger directly comparable to that audit; this is not a fresh confirmation.
interpretation_contract: This is a descriptive baseline stock-and-flow ledger, not calibration, confirmation or a policy scenario.
No model parameter or production transition is changed.
Each annual stock change must equal the sum of the recorded process contributions exactly for every candidate, seed, activity stratum and stock metric.
Activity movement is reported as not applicable because the production model has no activity-transition operator after assignment at entry.
The 2025 start-of-year stock is the end-of-2024 latent state relevant to forecast initialization.
